Set up GitHub Copilot agent hooks for this repository. Create exactly these files and nothing else.

1. .github/hooks/ai-logging.json
   Format: { "version": 1, "hooks": { ... } }.
   Register ONE command hook for each of these events: sessionStart, userPromptSubmitted,
   preToolUse, postToolUse, subagentStart, subagentStop, agentStop, sessionEnd.
   Each entry: { "type": "command", "command": "node .github/hooks/scripts/log-interaction.mjs <eventName>", "cwd": ".", "timeoutSec": 10 }.
   Use the relative script path exactly as written, because the absolute path of this repo contains spaces.

2. .github/hooks/format-dotnet.json
   One postToolUse command hook: "node .github/hooks/scripts/format-dotnet.mjs", cwd ".", timeoutSec 60.

3. .github/hooks/scripts/log-interaction.mjs  (Node, ES module, no npm dependencies)
   - Read the whole JSON payload from stdin. The event name comes from process.argv[2].
   - Accept both camelCase and snake_case field names (sessionId/session_id, toolName/tool_name,
     toolArgs/tool_input, toolResult/tool_response). Missing fields become null. Never throw.
   - Append ONE line of JSON to logs/ai-interactions.jsonl (create the folder if needed) with exactly these keys:
     ts (ISO-8601 UTC), sessionId, event, agent (agentName if present, else null),
     prompt (only for userPromptSubmitted, else null), tool (tool name or null),
     input (tool args or initialPrompt as a string), output (tool result text, subagent response,
     or stop reason as a string), files (array of repo-relative file paths found in the tool args, else []).
   - Truncate input and output to 2000 characters, adding "…[truncated]".
   - Redaction, applied to every string value BEFORE JSON.stringify: replace the user's home directory
     (os.homedir()) in backslash, forward-slash and URL-encoded (file:///c%3A/Users/...) forms, case-insensitive,
     with "~"; then replace any remaining occurrence of the bare user name (os.userInfo().username,
     case-insensitive) with "user". Never write environment variables.
     Replace anything that looks like a token (gho_, ghp_, github_pat_, sk-, "Bearer ") with "[redacted]".
   - Always exit with code 0, even on error. A failing preToolUse hook would block the tool.
   - Print nothing to stdout.

4. .github/hooks/scripts/format-dotnet.mjs  (Node, ES module, no npm dependencies)
   - Read the postToolUse payload from stdin and collect the edited file paths from the tool args.
   - Tool args may hold absolute paths or file:// URIs; convert each to a path relative to the repo root.
   - For each edited *.cs file, find the nearest .csproj walking up from that file and run
     dotnet format whitespace "<csproj>" --include "<relative file>" with execFileSync and an argument array
     (no shell), so paths with spaces work.
   - Skip silently if no .cs file was edited, if dotnet is missing, or if the format fails.
     Always exit with code 0. Print nothing to stdout.

5. logs/chat-exports/.gitkeep (empty file)

Do not change any other file. When you are done, list the files you created.
